visual_review.identity: Cool muted green-gray earthy ground with sparse dry tufts, small gray stone groups and exactly two simplified bare branch/root-like forms. No cemetery objects, glow or pools.
visual_review.detail_density: About 18-22 scattered accent groups. Stone groups and tufts are much sparser than the original, but broad soil patches still carry low-contrast fine mottling and small ragged boundaries.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Main stone faces and tuft groups read about 6-16 world units at a 256-unit source period, larger than the proposed 2-6 units. The two twig groups span around 18-23 units. Scale remains a scene-trial decision.
visual_review.style_caveat: Quiet matte palette and broad base patches; residual microtexture and pointed tuft leaves remain. Not the completely smooth paper-plane soil requested.
visual_review.native_acceptance: Opaque/dimensions passed and material identity retained; parent scene review pending. No seamlessness claim.
